05143.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station at Fayetteville Drake Field had 31.43 inches, 6.08 inches less than a usual year. June carried a lot of it with 11.08 inches, and the biggest single day was Jun 8 at 2.63 inches. The gauge then went 12 days in a row with nothing from Aug 25 to Sep 5. Last year by this date it had 52.60 inches, so this year is 21.17 inches less.

05145.story: Through Oct 13, the station in Georgetown had its wettest month in April at 5.33 inches, and its biggest one-day reading came Apr 29 at 2.96 inches. It went 16 days in a row with nothing in the gauge, from Jan 26 to Feb 10. On the days both years reported, this year is 21.66 inches less than 2025.

05149.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station in Dardanelle had May as the wettest month at 7.95 inches, and May 29 brought the biggest single day at 2.81 inches. The longest dry stretch ran 20 days, Jan 26 to Feb 14, with nothing in the gauge. On the days both years reported, this year is 18.78 inches less than 2025.
